findings: The pinned Wasmtime executor converts the declared memory import into an internal memory export and lets Wasmtime create it.
Heap allocation reads each module declared initial page count. Static allocation adds configured extra pages to that initial count; the default adds 2048.
A change from 45 to 46 initial pages therefore uses 2,094 total pages under the default static strategy, 64 KiB more than the baseline 2,093. No fixed baseline 45-page import is reused.
Structural review is supplemented by successful candidate Wasm instantiation and execution in the separate local exact-Wasm rehearsal. It does not inspect production operator heap settings.
